measurement.name: Median SASA
measurement.statistic: median over contributing RNA chain instances

aggregation_rules.contribution: one nucleotide measurement per RNA chain instance per Rfam consensus match position
aggregation_rules.eligibility: status 'complete' (all CCD heavy atoms observed; leaving atoms excluded)
aggregation_rules.excluded: incomplete and unsupported nucleotides are counted but not aggregated; insert/local-end/flank residues never aggregated; residues without coordinates never counted as zero

colour_domain_suggestion_A2.rule: 0 to the maximum median rounded up to the next 50 A^2

method.radii_source: Bondi (1964) van der Waals radii; P 1.80 (NACCESS)
method.altloc_policy: per atom name within a residue keep the highest-occupancy alternate location (ties: first altloc label); other copies dropped
method.chain_isolation: polymer atoms of the selected label_asym_id only (gemmi subchain); no other chains, ligands, ions or water
method.model: first model of the deposited/updated mmCIF
method.completeness_reference: wwPDB CCD heavy atoms minus pdbx_leaving_atom_flag=Y atoms (RCSB ligand CIF)
method.coordinate_source: PDBe updated mmCIF (same files as the mapping pipeline)
